name: Strings
listen_for: The set's strings instruments in turn: Violin, Viola, Cello, Contrabass, Tremolo strings, Pizzicato strings, Orchestral harp, Timpani.

name: Ensemble
listen_for: The set's ensemble instruments in turn: String ensemble, Slow strings, Synth strings, Soft synth strings, Choir aahs, Voice oohs, Synth voice, Orchestra hit.

name: DrumKit
listen_for: Every drum of the kit in turn, by its GM key, and then a groove on the kit.

name: Effects
listen_for: Each effect in turn, on the same phrase: Small room, Medium room, Large room, Medium hall, Large hall, Plate, Chorus, Stereo tremolo.
